summary: M.S. Computer Engineering graduate from Rochester Institute of Technology (RIT), NY focused on real-time perception for robotics on embedded and edge compute platforms. Built and calibrated multi-sensor pipelines (ToF, camera, IMU) integrated with ROS2 kinematics and TensorRT-optimized object detection on NVIDIA Jetson, achieving a 5.2x inference speedup for closed-loop robotic perception. Comfortable debugging across the full stack, from I2C/UART driver-level sensor issues to detection behavior on live hardware.

experience.title: Research Intern (Capstone)
bullets: Deployed ZoeDepth monocular depth estimation for crack-depth profiling with ±8% error on 3D surface reconstruction.
Architected a full metal surface inspection pipeline for microscopic crack analysis using custom image stitching, wavelet denoising, and depth estimation.

experience.title: Deep Learning Intern
bullets: Curated and annotated a custom object detection dataset for health-level classification using YOLOv8.
Trained YOLOv8n on 1,133 annotated images achieving 83% mAP@50 on held-out validation; exported to ONNX and TFLite for edge deployment.

experience.title: Embedded Systems Intern
bullets: Developed a wearable gesture-recognition sensor system integrating ADXL345 accelerometers with Raspberry Pi and HC-05 Bluetooth to translate 3-DoF hand motion into HID commands via Python.
Implemented a custom tap-detection algorithm using z-axis differential thresholding; resolved sensor jitter through software calibration and resolution tuning.

projects.name: Voice-Controlled Robotic Arm (COFFIN) — MS Capstone, RIT
bullets: Built a voice-controlled, vision-guided robotic pick-and-place system across a three-layer pipeline: Flutter client, Flask-SocketIO edge server, and Jetson+Arduino controller over a unified WebSocket fabric.
Integrated TensorRT-optimized YOLO (5.2x speedup: 56.7→10.9 ms) for visual servoing and dual VL53L0X ToF sensors for contact-aware grasping via TCA9548A I2C mux.
Resolved 11 integration failures (false-positive detections, servo brown-out, stale-frame capture); achieved 100% pick reliability (10/10 trials) at ~11.5s end-to-end voice-to-picked latency.

projects.name: ROS-Based Robotic Arm (AL5B & UR5e)
bullets: Derived DH tables and hand-computed full forward kinematic chains (0T6) for a 6-DoF UR5e and a 5-DoF AL5B; validated against MoveIt and RViz URDF models in ROS 2 Humble and ROS Noetic.
Planned and executed collision-free pick-and-place trajectories on physical UR5e via UR ROS 2 driver; AL5B repeatability measured at <2mm over 10 trials.

projects.name: Autonomous Driving in CARLA
bullets: Built automated data generation pipelines using CARLA's semantic segmentation and raycast occlusion filtering to produce ~5,000 YOLO and ~3,000 UFLD training frames with zero manual annotation.
Trained YOLO11n (mAP50~0.85) and fine-tuned UFLD (ResNet-18); integrated into an adaptive control stack with lane-following and waypoint fallback, validated across Town02 with zero collisions.

projects.name: Object Tracking Turret
bullets: Used YOLOv8 on NVIDIA Jetson to detect and track objects, sending control commands to STM32 over UART.
Used FreeRTOS with mutexes for shared-memory task coordination; integrated VL53L0X ToF sensing and OLED distance visualization.

awards: 1st Prize, Poster Presentation — 2D and 3D Image Mosaicing of Microscopic Images, F.C.R.I.T. (2024)
Ranked 10th, Robocon — National-level robotics competition among 45 universities (2022)
